annotate.intro: Mark positions on the client's PDF or photo. Saving stores a separate annotated copy; the original file is not changed. Area: press and drag. Scale: click both ends of a known length.
annotate.marksHint: Choose a tool and click on the image (press and drag for an area).
annotate.name: name
annotate.none: The project has no PDF or photo to annotate yet.
annotate.scalePrompt: Real distance between these two points (mm)

boq.editHint: Description, specs and quantity can be edited directly; a changed quantity is marked Manual, needs a reason and is listed at review.
boq.internalIntro: The diagram, drawing and calculations use this breakdown; the client BOQ shows only the summary lines above.
boq.intro: Grouped by area; each line spells out the specs and the quantity comes from the rules. No prices. Default lines are set in
boq.manualCount: {n} manual changes; each is listed at review.
boq.needReason: A changed quantity needs a reason; it saves once the reason is in.
boq.readonly: Multi-face: one group per face; fixed-quantity lines (e.g. the PC) are in the shared group at the end. Read-only for now.

calc.choices: The size is not a multiple of the module. Choose a valid size first:

confirm.autosave: Changes are saved to the draft about 1.2 s after you stop typing.
confirm.fillHint: Fills only empty fields; values already filled in are kept.
confirm.intro: Fields marked Medium / Low must each be confirmed before the rules run. Values typed in count as confirmed by the person who typed them. Module and cabinet sizes come from the cabinet chosen in the product library.
confirm.pending: {n} fields still need confirming; nothing is calculated until then.
confirm.previewHint: The original file is read-only; this is an excerpt for checking.
confirm.title: Confirm inputs

diagram.l1Intro: Generated from the internal BOQ breakdown: signal flows left to right, power comes from the DB box below. Dashed boxes are owner-supplied equipment and are not in the BOQ.
diagram.l2Intro: Models and quantities come from the product library and the internal BOQ breakdown; each connection shows its cable and breakdown line. Level 3 installation drawings come in the next version (mode B).
diagram.unmatched: Some equipment on the diagram is not in the BOQ breakdown: {items}

drawing.exportNote: Exports of an unapproved Rev carry a DRAFT watermark; file properties record the Rev, rule version and product library version. DXF: mm, 1:1, layers AVP-CABINET / AVP-CABINET-ID / AVP-POWER / AVP-DATA / AVP-DIM / AVP-NOTE, dimensions as DIMENSION entities.
drawing.hintData: Click a cabinet to move it to the next data cable; each cable's load is checked again right away.
drawing.hintPower: Click a cabinet to move it to the next circuit; each circuit's power is checked again right away.
drawing.intro: Generated from the F3 cabinet layout, F6 / F7 power circuits and F9 data cables; exports to DXF / DWG. Numbering starts at R1C1 bottom-left; data cables start on the left.
drawing.manualCount: {n} cabinets adjusted manually, saved with the Rev.
drawing.noOda: ODA File Converter is not installed on the server; install it to export DWG.
drawing.ok: Checks pass: each circuit ≤ {a} A and at most {chain} cabinets in a chain; each data cable ≤ {px} px.
drawing.over: {n} overloads, marked red. This Rev cannot be approved; change them back or click Reset to auto.
drawing.title: Cabinet & cabling drawing

faces.introLed: First decide whether the screen is a special shape. For multi-face screens (L, U…) enter each face's size, orientation and signal / power input points; a flat screen is entered as before.
faces.introPj: A single wall is entered as before; for L, U, curved, ring and wall + floor, enter each face's width, height, available depth and lens height — projector, lens and source are shared.
faces.name: Name
faces.overlapHint: e.g. B over A, A net width minus 20 mm
faces.perFaceLed: Each face has its own signal and power inputs: data cables, circuits and DB boxes are calculated per face.
faces.perFacePj: Projectors are laid out per face, never across a corner; empty height, depth and lens height use the confirmed inputs below.
faces.resolutionHint: e.g. B lowered 300 mm to stagger heights
faces.title: Shape & faces

flow.noResult: No results yet: confirm the inputs in 02–04 first.
flow.pullAsk: The drawing check was updated ({what}). Pull it in again?
flow.pullLater: 04 still has unconfirmed items; pull in after confirming them.
flow.saveBody: Save the current design as official version {v} and go to “{name}”. Drafts keep autosaving; only official versions can be submitted.

intake.bindNew: Creating the project binds the latest rules, product library and template versions. Later library updates do not affect it unless you upgrade by hand.
intake.bound: Bound at creation: rules {rules} · product library {library} · template {template}. Later library updates do not affect this project unless you upgrade by hand.
intake.intro: Fill this in once; every later step uses it. The project no. can be left empty and added later.
intake.lineHint: Multi-face and corner screens are chosen as the shape in 02–04.
intake.name: Project name
intake.required: Project name and client are required.

compare.missing: The project record lacks: {names}; related quantities cannot be calculated
compare.skipped: Multi-face project records have no per-face sizes; not compared yet.
compare.title: Recalculated with rules {version}, compared with actual quantities

kb.decidedIntro: Items already accepted or rejected; undo returns an item to “to confirm”, and an accepted one is reverted by saving another new version.

import.last: Last scan: {at} {time} · {new} new · {changed} changed · {removed} removed · {failed} could not be read
import.noFolder: Folder not found: ask IT to set knowledge_dir in deploy.local.yaml
import.note: Each document type has its own sub-folder; for past projects, one sub-folder per project. Original files are read-only: not moved or renamed. Rescanned automatically every night at {at}; new or changed files are read again.
import.title: Import

kb.intro: Put past project files, spec sheets, drawings, BOQs and templates in the knowledge base folder. The platform reads them one by one on the company server: extracts text, dimensions and tables and builds a full-text index. All processed locally, no cloud AI.
kb.noQty: What is learned never changes quantities directly
kb.noQtyText: : it only gives suggested values, sources and confidence. Anything going into the product library, templates or project records must be accepted by a person and creates a new version; rules are reference only and never changed automatically.

projects.intro: Each sub-folder of the past-projects folder is one project. Accept its project record under “Learned” first; projects ticked “Completed, use as reference answer” are recalculated with the current rules and compared line by line with the actual quantities. You can also put a standard.txt file in the past-projects folder, one project folder name per line.
projects.none: No past projects yet: put project folders in the past-projects folder and scan.
projects.title: Past projects

similar.intro: Scored by size, screen shape, pixel pitch and keywords in the files; only project records confirmed in the knowledge base are used.
similar.title: Similar past projects

to.product: Product library · {line} (replaces sample values; new version)
to.productAdd: Product library · {line} (added from the reference table; new version)
to.project: Project records · similar projects, regression comparison
to.rule: Rules · reference only, not changed automatically

used.boqText: Line wording from past BOQs that the template does not have yet becomes a default template row once accepted, with sizes and pixel pitch replaced by rule results.
used.productText: Load, network ports, brightness, power and lumens read from spec sheets replace the sample values in the product library once accepted.
used.regressionText: Completed projects are compared line by line with the rule results; differences are listed as a reference for adjusting coefficients.
used.similarText: When confirming inputs, the 3 most similar past projects are listed so you can compare size, screen shape and their solution directly.
used.title: Where it is used

login.intro: No password. Your name records who made and who reviewed each Rev.
login.name: Name
login.none: No names yet. Add one below.
login.title: Choose your name

manual.fromRec: Quantity comes from a manual value on the Recommendation tab

multi.conflictsIntro: The same size differs between sources; nothing is calculated until one is chosen.
multi.introLed: Each face is calculated with F1–F16 on its own (each has its own inputs), then S1–S7 check corners, canvas, processor outputs, special faces and source consistency together.
multi.introPj: Each face is laid out with P1–P10 on its own; blender, power and cables use the total projector count (P11–P17); P20 checks corner positions, P21 unfolds the canvas, P22 curved / ring correction.
multi.title: Multi-face recommendation

options.full: Full: media PC, blender, transmitters, switch

pj.intro: The elevation blend zones, plan positions and section shadow check are drawn from the P2–P10 results and the confirmed inputs; nothing is recalculated on the drawings. The proposal PDF, Word, JPG Boards and deck use the same drawings.
pj.multiLater: Projection drawings for multi-face walls (per face) come next; see the per-face results in 05 and the BOQ.

notes.elevation: Each image and the blend zones between neighbours (P4, P5)
notes.plan: Lens distance from the wall, throw cones and available depth (P3, P4)
notes.section: Light rays and the shadow zone for the person height in the rules (P10)

pj.title: Projection drawings

products.intro: Recommendations use only the products listed here. Editing creates a new library version; Revs already issued keep the version they used.

ratings.noSizes: Fill in the cabinet sizes first

products.retireHint: Set products no longer used to Retired; older versions are kept.
products.sampleWarn: Products marked Sample data are for testing the workflow; they are replaced once checklist group D is filled in.

project.filesIntro: Originals are stored read-only and never overwritten. A file uploaded again with the same name is stored as another copy. The server reads text and dimensions after upload.
project.grades: A: values read directly · B: values from OCR, each must be confirmed · C: kept with the project, not used for quantities.
project.noFiles: No files yet. PDF, Excel, JPG, PNG and DWG can be uploaded.

review.author: Author
review.biOnly: Bilingual is only available for the deck (PPT) for now; the BOQ Excel is the English client format. Pick Chinese or English for the other files.
review.deckIntro: Empty cover fields use the project values; the cover and last slide are fixed, the rest can be left out. Settings are saved with the Rev and locked on submission. Text and tables in the exported PPT are editable; diagrams are pictures you can replace.
review.diffFirst: First version: what differs from the rule values
review.draftOnly: This Rev is not approved: exports are drafts with a DRAFT watermark on every page. Official exports need approval.
review.hintApproved: Locked: inputs, rules version, library version, BOQ, template, files. Editing anything earlier auto-opens draft {v}; this version stays unchanged.
review.hintDraft: This is a draft. Go back to 05 or 06 and click “Next” to save an official version before submitting.
review.hintPending: Anyone can approve, including yourself (approver and time are recorded). Returning needs a comment. Resubmitting replaces this pending one.
review.hintReady: Submitting locks a snapshot and waits for approval.
review.hintReturned: Return comment: {note}. Fix it, save a new version in 05 / 06, then resubmit.
review.lang: Pick the language once for all files:
review.lockedVersions: Locked: rules {rules} · product library {library} · template {template}. Later versions do not change this Rev.
review.noDxf: This proposal has no cabinet drawing (projection, multi-face).
review.noManual: No manual changes; all quantities come from the rules.
review.official: Approved: official files. Each format and language is archived on first export; later downloads return the same file.
review.same: The two Revs are the same.
review.sendBackHint: You may review your own Rev; sending back unlocks it for changes.
review.snapshotChanged: Warning: recalculating with the locked versions gives a different result from when it was locked (the software changed). Please tell the developers.

rules.draftError: The changed rules have an error: {error}
rules.formulasIntro: Formula rules can have their formulas changed and tiers added (a row is used when its condition holds; the first match from the top wins). Step rules keep their steps in code; only parameters change. Functions: ceil, floor, round, min, max, abs.
rules.intro: All coefficients and formulas are changed here. Saving creates a new rule version; Revs already issued keep the version they were calculated with.
rules.kbRefs: From the knowledge base (reference only; rules are not changed automatically)
rules.nothingToSave: Change a value or formula before saving
rules.step: Step rule ({step}); the steps are in code.
rules.tryIntro: Filled in with the 143-Royal Plaza LED-1 inputs by default; the cabinet is recommended from the product library. After changing parameters or formulas, results for “{version}” and “After change” are shown side by side. Click a row to expand the formula.

templates.intro: Every proposal's client BOQ starts from these lines. {name} in the text is replaced by a rule result or input; the quantity is a fixed number (e.g. 1 lot) or a rule result. The template never calculates quantities.

wb.converted: Converted to project {no}; the pre-sales record and uploaded files come along.
wb.empty: No proposals yet. Click “+ New project” to start.
wb.intro: Every project follows one line: 01 Inquiry → 02–04 Drawings → 05 Design → 06 Drawings & BOQ → 07 Approval & export
wb.title: AV Workbench

wiring.applyParams: Apply {n} change(s) (saves a new rule version)
wiring.budgetIntro: First how many cabinets each circuit and each port can carry, then the number of circuits and ports, then the wiring. Green parameters come from datasheets or company standards; yellow ones are to be confirmed or sample values.
wiring.dataSummary: Data cables {runs} + {spare} spare · {n} data jumpers between cabinets ≈ {m} m · ports used {runs} / {ports}
wiring.editParams: Change parameters in the Rules Engine (saves a new rule version) →
wiring.editReason: Load budget changed on the design page ({project} · {proposal})
wiring.paramsNote: Changing a parameter saves a new rule version and upgrades this draft; locked versions stay as they are and other projects upgrade by hand.
wiring.powerSummary: Power cables {circuits} + {spare} spare · {n} power jumpers between cabinets ≈ {m} m
wiring.synced: The drawing, DXF and BOQ all use this wiring.
wiring.title: Wiring diagram

ws.blocked: There are blocking items; export is not possible until they are fixed.
ws.calcIntro: Every number in the Proposal: the formula as calculated, the parameters used and their status. Click a row to expand.
ws.fromLibrary: Recommendations come only from product library {version}: pixel pitch, environment and maintenance must all match; preferred products come first.
ws.missing: Missing inputs: {names}. Fill them in before a cabinet can be chosen from the library.
ws.noDiagram: Choose a cabinet and calculate the cabinet count before the diagram can be drawn.
ws.noDiagramMulti: The multi-face diagram comes next; see the per-face results and the BOQ for now.
ws.suggestedIntro: No processor / controller in the library has enough load and ports. Below are processors with sending from the reference table; values still need checking against the datasheet. Add one to the library and the proposal recalculates.
